hero.eyebrow: Pete Guzzo, Executive Producer + Operations Strategist
hero.title: When content, production, marketing, operations, studios, and business strategy are all tangled together and nobody owns the full picture, that's the problem I fix.
hero.body: Brands, agencies, studios, founders, and production teams. I build the systems, run the productions, connect creative to business outcomes, and work with financial and operations teams on cost reduction, analysis, and cash flow planning that actually holds up.

servicesLeft.title: Executive Production
servicesLeft.body: Budget, crew, timeline, client. I run the production from first call to delivery — not just the creative side of it.

servicesLeft.title: Direction + Creative Lead
servicesLeft.body: Commercials, documentaries, branded content. I've been on enough sets to know where things break before they do.

servicesLeft.title: Studio Design + Build-out
servicesLeft.body: I design studios as operating systems — built for output and revenue, not just for looking good on a facility tour.

servicesLeft.title: Content + Marketing Strategy
servicesLeft.body: I connect what gets made to what moves the business. KPIs, not just views.

servicesRight.title: Production Operations
servicesRight.body: Systems and workflows that make repeatable output possible. Not just one good shoot — the infrastructure that keeps it going.

servicesRight.title: Financial Analysis + Planning
servicesRight.body: Cost reduction, financial analysis, and cash flow forecasts that actually hold up — built with operations teams, not handed down from above.

servicesRight.title: Business + Media Consulting
servicesRight.body: When the problem isn't creative — it's ownership, timeline, or communication — I help fix that too.

servicesRight.title: Studio Operations Management
servicesRight.body: Running the facility as a business: scheduling, revenue systems, vendor relationships, and the decisions that don't wait for a meeting.

services.heading: What I actually do
services.intro: I'm not just a video guy, a marketer, a producer, or a consultant. Most of what I do is the part nobody sees: building the plan, running the production, fixing the workflow, and connecting the creative to the business outcome it's supposed to drive.

whoHiresMe.heading: Who hires me
whoHiresMe.body: Brands and agencies with too many moving parts and no single operating plan. Founders building a studio who don't want to learn that lesson the expensive way. Production teams that need someone who can sit with executives, crews, vendors, and owners, and keep the thing moving.

aboutTeaser.heading: About Pete
aboutTeaser.quote: Twenty-plus years in branded content, film, and TV. None of that is the point, the point is knowing where this stuff actually gets messy, and how to make it work anyway.
